description.value: A 52-week Phase III randomized, double-blind, parallel-group trial in patients with behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia comparing hydromethylthionine doses and examining plasma exposure-response relationships for clinical and MRI outcomes.

spans.text: We undertook a 52-week Phase III study in 220 bvFTD patients randomized to compare hydromethylthionine at 200 mg/day and 8 mg/day (intended as a control).

description.value: A randomized, controlled, double-blind, parallel-group trial conducted between May 2013 and February 2016.
